title: NOAA National Water Model retrospective streamflow (CONUS reach network)
description:
NOAA NWM Retrospective v2.1, `chrtout.zarr`: streamflow at every NHDPlusV2 reach (plus arbitrary reach IDs outside CONUS), 1979-02-01 hourly onward. `streamflow` is [time, feature_id], shape [367439, 2776738] -- confirmed from the store's own `.zarray` -- chunked [672, 30000]. This is a 1-D, per-feature time series over a river-network graph, not a 2-D raster: there is no x/y/lat-lon grid to read a tile from at all (feature_id indexes a reach, not a pixel), and a lat/lon-looking `latitude`/`longitude` pair exists only as per-feature point coordinates (`coordinates: lat lon` on the variable), not an affine grid.

License: NOAA operational model output, public domain (US government work).

Expected browser outcome: refused cleanly as not a raster; must never attempt to fetch an 80MB-class chunk ([672,30000] int32 = ~80MB) just to probe shape.

feature_id.description: NHDPlusV2 ComID (reach identifier), not a spatial grid axis.

streamflow.description: Per-reach time series, not a raster. coordinates: latitude longitude (point locations per feature, not a grid).

data.title: NWM retrospective v2.1 CHRTOUT (Zarr V2, consolidated)
